decision: Exclude the DBLSPACE.EXE C version header from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The header describes its use by DBLSPACE.EXE to check the internal DBLSPACE.BIN revision.
No include of ds_vers.h was found in the retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include source trees or selected build reports.
The separate assembler ds_vers.inc remains in the core source tree for its own ordered review.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected IO.SYS, MSDOS.SYS and COMMAND.COM build; it does not cover building DBLSPACE.EXE or DBLSPACE.BIN.
